answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through hardware-rooted attestation. Agents must execute inside secure enclaves encased in opaque sable resin. Before admission from an intake lagoon, an internal cipher signs memory measurements using a factory-fused key. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of procuring discrete physical cryptoprocessors per identity. However, side-channel leaks can expose private keys, enabling forged attestations on commodity hardware.
